item.title: Notify NYC - Protest Activity - Foley Square (MN)
item.description:
Notification issued 10-09-2026 at 07:24 PM.
Due to protest activity, expect intermittent road closures, traffic delays and a heavy presence of emergency personnel near Foley Square in Manhattan. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.

item.title: Notify NYC - Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert - Henry Ackie (NYC)
item.description:
Alert issued 10-09-2026 at 06:58 PM.
A Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert has been issued for Henry Ackie, a 75-year-old black male from Brooklyn, Kings County. The missing may be in need of medical attention.
Description: 5'6" tall, 150lbs, with gray hair and brown eyes. Wearing a burgundy shirt with black sleeves, blue shorts, and brown slippers.
Last Seen: East 48th Street in Brooklyn, NY at approximately 8:00 PM on 10-08-2026.
If you see the missing person, please call NYCPD Missing Person Squad at 800-577-8477 or call 9-1-1.
A photo of the missing is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sFo7Qm

item.title: Notify NYC - 2026 Alpha Win Big Apple Triathlon - 10/10
item.description:
Notification issued 10-09-2026 at 05:35 PM.
As part of the 2026 Alpha Win Big Apple Triathlon, there will be multiple rolling street closures in The Bronx & Manhattan on 10/10, at the discretion of the NYPD.
The following locations will be closed:
Manhattan: The Henry Hudson Parkway (northbound) between West 58th Street and the Henry Husdon Bridge West 96th Street between the Henry Hudson Parkway and Central Park West
The Bronx: The Henry Hudson Parkway (Northbound) between the Henry Hudson Bridge and Mosholu Parkway Mosholu Parkway (Eastbound) between the Henry Hudson Parkway and West Gun Hill Road
Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible. Use local mass transit if possible.
